verdict.rationale: Evidence shows only a generic 'safety-best-practices' guide with a free Moderation API and a separate 'evals' feature for testing custom output criteria, plus one HN comment from an OpenAI employee about publishing benchmark evals for model comparisons — none of this documents red-teaming, frontier-model risk assessments, or a formal responsible-release/preparedness framework. Missing for 10: published red-teaming results, system cards or capability/risk assessments for frontier models, a documented preparedness/responsible-scaling framework with enforcement mechanisms, and third-party audit evidence.
